headline: MIA @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 5.15 at COL 4.44, with a projected total of 9.58. The projected total climbed +0.81, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sandy Alcantara has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for TJ Rumfield, Jake McCarthy, Xavier Edwards, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brian Navarreto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
